conditional_scenarios.name: rear wood-to-wood gross-EA aligned-row surrogate
conditional_scenarios.comparison_scope: Conditional elastic axial-row surrogate ONLY; not applicable complete candidate factor
conditional_scenarios.physical_inputs: Two actual centers, modeled gross member areas and E; nominal diameter. Hypothetical force aligned with centerline and axial member load paths.
applicability_failures: Actual centerline is oblique to both member grains
Actual individual forces not uniform or aligned with row
Saved local force couples cannot be replaced by scalar axial-row demand
Effective axial transfer areas and calibrated slip are not established

conditional_scenarios.name: header 41.275mm two-fastener row, 1 gross steel strip(s)
conditional_scenarios.comparison_scope: Conditional elastic axial-row surrogate ONLY; not applicable complete candidate factor
conditional_scenarios.physical_inputs: Wood gross EA; E steel200000MPa times modeled6.35x88.9mm strip. Two strips assumes simultaneous equal-action participation, not verified.
applicability_failures: Formed fitting effective EA/heel bending not equal to full gross axial strip by proof
